tasks.name: graphify-update
args: if command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ]; then graphify update . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; if ! git diff --quiet -- graphify-out/graph.json; then echo 'graphify: knowledge graph is stale. graph.json was regenerated from your changes.'; echo 'Commit it (plus GRAPH_REPORT.md) and push again:'; echo '  git add graphify-out/graph.json graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md && git commit'; exit 1; fi; else echo 'graphify not installed or no graph present - skipping graph freshness check.'; fi
